reasoning: The changes to the Trans-Tasman IP Attorneys Board (TTIAP) complaints webpage clarify and expand the information about when complaints can be made against IP attorneys, the complaint process, and outcomes. The other changes relate to administrative tribunal rules, privacy, defence, and other legislation that do not specifically affect the content about when to engage legal professionals for IP matters on the IPFR page.
